arena.requirements: Invoice to an insured or creditworthy foreign buyer; assignment notified to the debtor. A non-recourse factor does not buy an invoice whose debtor has already announced a delay.
Export contract or shipping documents; repaid in USD with the export proceeds.
Two years of financial statements; collateral or personal guarantee.
Pre-approved line on the current account.
Online onboarding; funds in 24 h. With recourse: if the buyer has not paid 30 days after the expected date, the exporter repays the advance.
Supplier enrolled in the bank's confirming program.
Net annual sales up to 100,000 UF (medium firms 25,001-100,000 UF get 50% guarantee coverage); financing up to 15,000 UF; no protests or overdue debts.

alert.en: Shanghai Hongxin Fresh Fruit Import Co. will pay USD 180,000 45 days late. 81% chance cash goes negative on 2026-12-30 (harvest payroll CLP 238.0M).
alert.es: Shanghai Hongxin Fresh Fruit Import Co. pagará USD 180.000 con 45 días de atraso. 81% de probabilidad de caja negativa el 2026-12-30 (nómina de cosecha CLP 238,0M).
alert.zh: 上海客户的 180,000 美元货款将延迟 45 天支付。2026-12-30（采收工资 23,800万智利比索 发放日）现金为负的概率为 81%。

plan.en: Best plan: 60-day pre-export loan of USD 142,400. Cost CLP 2.1M vs CLP 3.8M for the bank loan (45% cheaper). Cash stays above the buffer in 96% of 10,000 scenarios.
plan.es: Mejor plan: crédito de pre-exportación (PAE) por USD 142.400 a 60 días. Costo CLP 2,1M vs CLP 3,8M del crédito bancario (45% más barato). La caja se mantiene sobre el colchón en el 96% de 10.000 escenarios.
plan.zh: 最优方案：60天期出口前融资（PAE）142,400美元。成本 211万智利比索，银行贷款需 380万智利比索（节省 45%）。在 10,000 个模拟情景中，96% 的情景现金保持在安全垫之上。

approval.en: Approve this plan? Reply with the 6-digit code we just sent by SMS. Cost CLP 2.1M.
approval.es: ¿Apruebas este plan? Responde con el código de 6 dígitos que te enviamos por SMS. Costo CLP 2,1M.
approval.zh: 是否批准此方案？请回复我们刚通过短信发送的6位验证码。成本 211万智利比索。

analysis.basis: Contracted view: each invoice is paid at its due date plus any announced delay plus the customer's median delay, at today's FX and the expected cherry price. The Monte Carlo adds the uncertainty (prob_negative_after on each payroll).
